recent_articles.title: A Maharashtra BJP pick for MLC polls with connection to Pawars: Who is Arun Lakhani? | Political Pulse News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Arun Lakhani**, a prominent Maharashtra BJP leader and close associate of Union Minister **Nitin Gadkari** and Chief Minister **Devendra Fadnavis**, has been nominated to represent the Wardha-Chandrapur-Gadchiroli Local Authorities constituency in the upcoming June 18 state MLC elections.  Lakhani's nomination has sparked debate due to his lack of local roots within the constituency, but he is a familiar face within the party and known for his work in infrastructure development and social initiatives. His son, Sarang Lakhani, is engaged to NCP (SP) MP **Supriya Sule’s** daughter, Revati, further adding to the political intrigue surrounding his candidacy.

recent_articles.title: Maharashtra clears mine project, says not in tiger area; maps show otherwise | Mumbai News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Maharashtra** government exempted an iron ore mining project in Gadchiroli from wildlife clearance, claiming it was not within a tiger corridor. However, the project site is located within forest compartments identified as part of the Tadoba-Indravati tiger corridor, according to official records reviewed by The Indian Express.  The **National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA)** has previously clarified that corridors identified in approved TCPs should be considered for scrutiny of project proposals under the Wildlife Act. Despite this, the **Maharashtra** government's Chief Wildlife Warden initially exempted the project and later withdrew his letter after a review.

recent_articles.title: Suman Kalyanpur death: Veteran playback singer dies at 89 in Mumbai - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suman Kalyanpur**, a celebrated Indian playback singer, died on Sunday evening at the age of 89 in Mumbai.  The veteran singer, known for her melodious voice and classical finesse, left behind a rich musical legacy spanning over six decades. **Maharashtra Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis**, along with other prominent figures like **Sharad Pawar** and **Eknath Shinde**, mourned the loss of the "divine voice" who enriched India's musical heritage.  Her timeless songs in Marathi, Hindi, and several regional languages will continue to resonate with audiences for years to come.

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati.  Joining **Sarma** were four other MLAs who took oaths as Ministers: **Rameswar Teli**, **Ajanta Neog**, **Atul Bora**, and **Charan Boro**. The event was attended by prominent figures including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin**. This marks the formation of a third successive NDA government in the state.

recent_articles.title: Union Minister Pemmasani urges Nitin Gadkari to resolve traffic woes at Guntur bypass - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chandra Sekhar Pemmasani**, Union Minister of State for Rural Development and Communications, met with **Nitin Gadkari**, Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways, to address traffic congestion and road safety concerns at the Chinnakakani junction near Kaza tollgate on the Guntur-Vijayawada National Highway.  **Pemmasani** requested the Ministry to construct either a grade-separated interchange or a uni-directional flyover to improve vehicular movement and enhance commuter safety. **Gadkari** responded positively, directing officials to examine the issue and initiate necessary action.

recent_articles.title: Ministers, ambassadors, artists to join The Hindu’s Huddle in June - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Hindu Group** is hosting its annual **The Hindu Huddle**, a conference focused on global issues, in Bengaluru from June 5th to 6th. This year's theme, "A World in Transition," will feature discussions on topics such as regional parties in Indian democracy, diplomacy and conflict resolution, women's representation in Parliament, the role of AI, mental health, and the future of work.  The event will include prominent speakers from India and around the world, including Union Ministers Hardeep Puri and Nitin Gadkari, former President Mohamed Nasheed, and Chinese Ambassador Xu Feihong.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal: Modi's BJP conquers one of India's toughest political frontiers
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) won a decisive victory in West Bengal, marking a significant breakthrough for **Narendra Modi** and his 12-year reign.  This unexpected outcome comes after years of the party's struggle to gain traction in the state, which has traditionally been dominated by the Trinamool Congress (TMC). The BJP's success is attributed to a combination of factors, including its aggressive welfare pitch, sharpened Hindu consolidation efforts, and a focus on alleged corruption within the TMC. This victory will likely have far-reaching implications for the BJP's future trajectory, potentially solidifying **Amit Shah**'s position as Modi's successor.

recent_articles.title: Fadnavis backs ex-CJI amid row over meeting with Dhirendra Shastri - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Maharashtra Chief Minister**,  came out in support of former Chief Justice of India (CJI) B.R. Gavai after social activist Shyam Manav criticized his meeting with Dhirendra Shastri, chief priest of the Bageshwar Dham.  Manav argued that Gavai should not claim the legacy of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar and challenged Shastri to accept an anti-superstition panel's challenge. Senior Congress leader Vijay Wadettiwar accused political leaders of elevating babas (religious figures) in Maharashtra, criticizing Gavai for meeting Shastri.  The controversy comes after a similar incident involving Shastri's claims about Shivaji Maharaj.

recent_articles.title: PM inaugurates Delhi-Dehradun expressway - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** inaugurated a six-lane Delhi-Dehradun expressway, a ₹12,000-crore project that is expected to reduce travel time between the two cities. The 213-km corridor will connect key towns in Uttar Pradesh and integrate with major national corridors. **Mr. Modi** highlighted the project's transformative impact on regional connectivity, trade, industry, and tourism.  The project also includes wildlife corridors and amenities for improved safety and access to markets. **Nitin Gadkari**, Union Minister for Road Transport and Highways, emphasized ongoing infrastructure development in Uttarakhand, including projects aimed at improving access to pilgrimage centers.

recent_articles.title: Assam Assembly election 2026: Curtains down on high-voltage campaign - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The Assam Assembly elections concluded on April 7, with voters casting their ballots for the state's 126 seats. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and other BJP leaders campaigned against the opposition Congress, accusing it of promoting infiltrators and failing to address development issues. The Congress countered by highlighting corruption allegations against the ruling party and promising justice for singer Zubeen Garg if elected. Prominent candidates include Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, Gaurav Gogoi (Congress), Badruddin Ajmal (AIUDF), and Debabrata Saikia (opposition).  The elections will be held in a single phase on April 9th.

recent_articles.title: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw flags poor condition of Hosur Road; NHAI responds - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw**, executive chairperson of **Biocon Limited**, criticized the poor condition of Hosur Road, a key IT corridor in India, on social media. The **National Highways Authority of India (NHAI)** responded, explaining that the road was completed in 2010 and faces challenges due to high traffic volumes and ongoing infrastructure projects.  The NHAI stated that work is underway to address issues such as median crash barriers, asphalting, and utility works impacting the stretch.

recent_articles.title: Kerala Assembly Elections 2026: Satheesan accuses Pinarayi of being an RSS agent - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V.D. Satheesan**, leader of the Opposition, countered **Pinarayi Vijayan**, Chief Minister of Kerala, by posting old photographs of CPI(M) leaders alongside BJP figures to refute accusations of bowing to the RSS.  Satheesan argued that the CPI(M) has had clandestine ties with the RSS throughout history and accused Vijayan of being an RSS agent. He cited examples like the 1977 election victory, support for V.P. Singh in 1989, and alleged secret dealings with RSS leaders.

recent_articles.title: Cabinet colleagues laud PM Modi’s record breaking 8,931 days in public office - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** surpassed former Sikkim Chief Minister Pawan Chamling's record of 8930 days in office, becoming India’s longest-serving head of government.  His Cabinet colleagues congratulated him, praising his dedication to the nation and commitment to service. **Modi**, the first Indian PM born after independence, has led his party to three consecutive Lok Sabha election victories.

recent_articles.title: Kerala CM Pinarayi Vijayan slams CPI(M) defectors, cites rise of ‘parliamentary ambitions’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Pinarayi Vijayan**, Kerala Chief Minister, addressed the recent defections of three CPI(M) leaders who are contesting as Independents. He expressed concern over their decision to contest against the party and labeled it a betrayal. **Vijayan** stated that these leaders had long political legacies and should not have joined forces with rivals.  He also defended the party's decision to field P.K. Shyamala, wife of CPI(M) State secretary M.V. Govindan, from Taliparamba, asserting that she was a senior leader in her own right.
